Toronto Raptors — injuries
Quickley (hamstring) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
Quickley is in danger of missing a second consecutive contest due to a right hamstring injury. If the 27-year-old point guard remains sidelined, Jamal Shead and Alijah Martin would be candidates for increased playing time.
